description: AI CAD, as on techdrawai.com/app/ai-cad: turn a written description into an exact, editable CAD part: a STEP file for CAD programs (Fusion, SolidWorks, FreeCAD, Onshape), an STL for 3D printing and a 3MF for slicers, modelled by TechDraw AI's AI CAD agent, which writes build123d (OpenCascade) code, runs it, measures the result and checks it against the request. Dimensions are exact, not estimated: put every size the user gave in the prompt. Best for brackets, enclosures, mounts, flanges, adapters, spacers, gears and other mechanical parts. Up to three photos, sketches or drawings can go in `images` (sizes written on them are used exactly). To change a part already made, pass its project_id with the change. Starts a background job (two to eight minutes) and returns a job_id for check_job. Costs 80 credits and requires the Studio plan; refunded if nothing is built.

images.description: Up to three photos, sketches or drawings: local file paths, http(s) URLs or data:image URLs.

project_id.description: A project_id from an earlier text_to_cad or drawing_to_3d job, to change that part.

prompt.description: The part: what it is, every dimension in mm, holes, fillets, material.

name: text_to_cad
title: Model a CAD part from a description
